_metadata.description: Optional mDNS auto-discovery of the control plane on a trusted LAN; manual URL+code remains the cross-network default.

requirements.title: LAN Auto-Discovery
requirements.description: On a trusted LAN, the bootstrap can discover the control plane automatically (mDNS) so pairing is 'run the installer' rather than 'find and type the control-plane URL,' while the manual URL+code path remains the cross-network default.

validation.notes: mDNS discovery locates an advertised control plane on the LAN and falls back cleanly to manual URL when absent.
Off-LAN bootstrap uses the manual URL+code path without depending on mDNS.
